headline: Latent models link histology, spatial transcriptomics and single-cell states
label: Spatial Omics Latent Models
summary: Histology-to-molecule foundation models and 3D atlas methods now couple morphology with spatial and single-cell omics readouts.
synthesis: The dominant thread is structured latent representation of spatial and single-cell omics, with several items linking morphology to molecular readouts. Loki2 recovers transcriptomic and protein signals and morphology-linked latents from H&E images, GenVinci reconstructs 3D molecular tissue scenes from histology, and sc-HistoMorphomics links 194 nuclear morphology features to spatial transcriptomics. Space-map aligns serial sections into 3D single-cell atlases, and SOUR separates heritable lineage from microenvironmental effects on tumor gene expression. Statistical assessment is a shared emphasis: velotest quantifies RNA velocity embedding fidelity, and MiSA tests spatial dysbiosis. TMCells and the hybrid mixture model offer non-spatial probabilistic alternatives.
